wiki.title: Anne Stava
wiki.extract: Anne Stava (formerly Stava-Murray) is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 81st district. She took office on January 9, 2019. The 81st district, located in DuPage and Will counties, includes all or portions of Downers Grove, Lisle, Naperville, Woodridge, Darien, Westmont, and Bolingbrook. Stava is engaged to Marcus King, a candidate for DuPage County Board.
